scope: In-process negative tenant test for reading an existing report export artifact through GET /reports/exports/:exportId.

repository_identity.note: Evidence is bound to this dirty worktree at the recorded HEAD; it is not candidate or release evidence.

scenario.setup: The in-memory ReportsService creates a financial-payables execution and CSV export under the owner account.
scenario.request: A principal whose user and session both belong to the foreign account requests the existing export ID.
assertions: The route rejects with NotFoundError, code NOT_FOUND, HTTP status 404, and the generic message Report export not found.
The error details do not include the foreign account ID.
No audit write occurs for the rejected foreign-account request.
